executive_summary: Globalisation integrates national economies through MNC supply chains, technology, and 1991 trade liberalisation. It creates uneven outcomes across social strata.

storyboard.title: MNC Global Supply Chains
storyboard.description: Showing US R&D, Chinese manufacturing, and Indian call center operations.
storyboard.key_takeaway: MNCs locate operations to minimize production costs.

video_embeds.title: 1991 Liberalisation & WTO Governance
video_embeds.transcript_summary: Covers tariff removals, containerization, WTO trade negotiations, and SEZ policies.

hotspots.popover_content: MNCs invest foreign direct capital via joint ventures, company buyouts, and local sub-contracting.

key_takeaways: MNCs connect global markets via foreign investment.
1991 liberalisation removed trade tariffs and quotas.
Globalisation benefits skilled urban elites while pressuring small manufacturers.
Fair globalisation requires state support for small units and labor law enforcement.
